opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Regular Grant under £100,000; support tends to be approximately 10-20% of an organisation's costs; for local community projects grants are likely to be no greater than £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt or excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return); must work within the UK or UK Overseas Territories; cannot have applied within the past year.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK charities for operating/core costs, capital projects (building works, repairs, equipment), or specific projects/activities. Open all year round with no deadlines.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs: organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. For capital or project costs: the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (regardless of annual income). Must be an eligible UK charity (registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted).
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and over for capital/project costs or core costs, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Expression of Interest can be submitted all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis.
